secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key for the project at ylqwyhifwhksntnmodzc.supabase.co — needed for all server-side DB operations (credits, billing, admin, projects). Find it in Supabase Dashboard → Settings → API → service_role key.

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe secret API key (sk_live_... or sk_test_...) for billing/checkout. Find it in Stripe Dashboard → Developers → API keys.

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_...) for verifying webhook payloads. Find it in Stripe Dashboard → Developers → Webhooks → your endpoint.

secrets.name: FORGE_ADMIN_KEY
secrets.description: Shared secret key that admin clients must present to access the admin API. Generate a random string.

secrets.name: FORGE_ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Password/secret used to sign admin session tokens. Generate a random string.

secrets.name: FORGE_SECRETS_ENCRYPTION_KEY
secrets.description: AES-GCM key (32-byte hex or base64 string) used to encrypt per-project secrets at rest. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

secrets.name: GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: GitHub OAuth App client ID for repo import/push features. Find it in GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → OAuth Apps.

secrets.name: GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: GitHub OAuth App client secret. Find it in GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → OAuth Apps.

secrets.name: GITHUB_OAUTH_CALLBACK_URL
secrets.description: The callback URL registered in your GitHub OAuth App (e.g. https://your-domain/api/public/github/callback).
